narratives.Description: Upgrade the complete Directive training baseline from 0.119.9 to 0.119.11 and refresh the local framework deposit to match.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Upgrade the complete Directive training baseline from 0.119.9 to the latest published release, 0.119.11, and refresh the local framework deposit to match.

This is a course-wide rebind, not a metadata-only dependency bump. The root package pin is coupled to learner-facing content, fixtures, verification code, and release evidence.

## Bound release identity

- npm @deftai/directive integrity sha512-bOifUXvj+ITQ8GYGXQ+B4tCvmzEm/AFzZodr4QpGB58iNIrmyFJw2UqBUOn9fvNjX2AUaaWUNFcH4HI8TjQeRw==
- npm @deftai/directive-core integrity sha512-Q48p4YBd9Pow7QfwYCAPRDoofg588Ty7CpaDmxEn08Pv8ZKvaEjK8Fw5Ttuaae2oFsHGtmaWR1df4CLE0cEfHg==
- npm @deftai/directive-content integrity sha512-ZROZ6BHweez7z/2hne+w2v9rlPmRxA+PIyvSR7RpDENp3ywF28ylKzifUSGXsFu86FolHygAjSq4WvwkJO2ccg==
- npm @deftai/directive-types integrity sha512-oJP1zEpDxweN3n40JKOuLCaGB6XTFXlP8YAURc80ZDitcBuiOIdkVAFalGJZr7b53YwJ44mVZcenCwAc16Nz3w==
- npm gitHead / peeled release commit 3e47fe5f1fb34438f4a17784eb82d71dd9af5970
- annotated tag object ad36c781b0142bc68c68b6e02b615ca381e42311

0.119.10 gitHead 6dea8b59bc91dfda8f16cf2f77b443ae543e08bc is an intermediate publication. Bind current teaching to 0.119.11.

## Current evidence

Global CLI is already @deftai/directive@0.119.11. Consumer deposit and teaching pin remain 0.119.9. Doctor reports engine 0.119.11 ahead of pin 0.119.9; AGENTS.md managed section stale; missing verify:presentation-ceiling, verify:presentation-coverage, verify:durable-effect-acquisition in the 0.119.9 deposit. Next deposit command: deft update from this feature-branch worktree, then deft migrate (idempotent) and deft doctor.

## Scope

Run deft update and keep the generated 0.119.11 deposit, managed AGENTS section, and related framework paths. Re-probe 0.119.11 behavior and update current curriculum, labs, solutions, assessment, references, maintenance guidance, workflow assertions, fixtures, guards, and verification scripts. Pin all six disposable fixture graphs exactly to CLI/core/content/types 0.119.11. Classify each 0.119.9 occurrence as current evidence to update, explicitly historical evidence to preserve, or superseded material to remove. Do not mechanically relabel history. Keep 0.119.5 historical evidence historical. Add a Keep a Changelog entry under Unreleased. Deliver on a feature branch. Envelope is stop-at pr-open.

## Safety boundary

All mutation probes run only in unique disposable repositories with no remote.

## Acceptance commands

npm run test:teaching-baseline
npm run check:cold-start-readme
npm run test:baseline-upgrade
npm run test:portability
npm test
git diff --check
deft xbrief:validate
deft check
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive learner or maintainer, I want the repository current guidance, executable examples, and lifecycle records to satisfy Directive 0.119.11, so that training follows one verified framework generation and the delivery gates remain trustworthy.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Refresh the dest deposit with deft update, deft migrate, and deft doctor, keeping generated 0.119.11 framework paths.
2. Re-probe changed command behavior in unique disposable repositories, then rebind current learner, maintainer, fixture, workflow, and verifier surfaces while preserving explicitly historical evidence.
3. Pin and verify all six disposable fixture graphs at CLI/core/content/types 0.119.11.
4. Record Unreleased changelog, run focused and aggregate checks, open a PR, and stop-at pr-open.
